name: Salalah

queries.query: Salalah Oman official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS Ministry Housing Urban Planning
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, Gov.om land services, and the Aqari real-estate portal. Official pages describe interactive maps and parcel services, but no anonymous public parcel ID-plus-geometry response or documented open parcel API was verified.

queries.query: صلالة عمان خريطة قطع الأراضي السجل العقاري وزارة الإسكان والتخطيط العمراني
queries.result: أكد البحث العربي الرسمي اختصاص وزارة الإسكان والتخطيط العمراني وخدمات الأراضي والسجل العقاري في صلالة، مع وجود المديرية العامة للإسكان والتخطيط العمراني بمحافظة ظفار في صلالة. وصف Gov.om خرائط جغرافية تفاعلية آمنة، لكن الوصول يتطلب حسابًا شخصيًا ولم تُتح استجابة عامة آمنة تتضمن هوية قطعة وهندسة.

registryEvidence.custodian: Oman Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning; General Directorate of Housing and Urban Planning in Dhofar Governorate, Salalah.
registryEvidence.basis: The Ministry open-data contact directory explicitly lists the Dhofar directorate in Salalah and the services portal identifies the Ministry as the provider of land and real-estate-registry services. This evidences a local custodial office, not an open parcel-data feed.

officialSources.observation: Official Ministry directory lists the General Directorate of Housing and Urban Planning in Dhofar Governorate at Salalah and the wilayat coverage includes Salalah.
officialSources.scope: Local custodian and administrative coverage; no parcel schema, CRS, identifiers, or geometry endpoint.

officialSources.observation: Official Gov.om service says eligible users choose residential land through interactive maps displaying plot location/details in a secure digital environment; it requires a personal account and identity documents.
officialSources.scope: Authenticated service workflow; not an anonymous parcel-data API.

officialSources.observation: Official Aqari portal advertises interactive property mapping and personal property details, then presents phone-number, national-authentication and OTP login steps.
officialSources.scope: Authentication wall; no anonymous parcel layer, safe ID+geometry response, schema, or CRS verified.

officialSources.observation: Official Ministry site exposes Lands, Real Estate Registry, Urban Planning, and GIS-related ministry content, but its live shell timed out during direct retrieval in this attempt.

requests.outcome: Direct curl request timed out after 20 seconds; no response body or service configuration was recovered.

Official portal was identified through first-party search, but the public surface is an Aqari login flow requiring phone number, national authentication/identity confirmation, and OTP. No login or credential use was attempted.
Official service description confirms secure interactive maps and plot details for eligible authenticated applicants; no anonymous map/API payload was exposed in the retrieved evidence.
Official directory evidence identifies the Dhofar/Salalah local directorate and its supervised wilayat coverage; no parcel layer or service schema was present in the indexed page.

Arabic official e-services category confirms land-registry services for citizens/residents, including applications, transaction inquiries, and document uploads; no public parcel geometry response was verified.

source: Oman Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning / وزارة الإسكان والتخطيط العمراني

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Dhofar Governorate housing and urban-planning directorate at Salalah; Ministry land and real-estate-registry services cover Salalah.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous public parcel ID-plus-geometry response, viewer schema, CRS, or bounded citywide parcel extent was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The Ministry and its Salalah/Dhofar directorate are first-party evidenced, and official services refer to interactive plot maps, but anonymous digital parcel availability, current public viewer/API routes, native field names, schema, CRS, and citywide coverage remain unknown. The exact WUP point was preserved and not used to infer citywide absence.
